metadata.title: Synthetic Zambia climate, population and air-quality dataset
metadata.description: SYNTHETIC data for teaching matplotlib. Patterns are plausible (rainy season Nov-Apr, wetter north, drier south-west, a 2024 drought year, dry-season PM2.5 peaks from burning, smelter SO2 in Copperbelt and North-Western) but values are NOT real measurements.

units.pm25_ugm3: micrograms per cubic metre, monthly mean
units.so2_ugm3: micrograms per cubic metre, monthly mean
